notes: INSIDE half of the Kett Hive Swarm Launcher: a brood chamber of honeycomb cells that fill with drones as it charges (frame 5 = every cell holds a drone, strip green), power coupling, hatch. fire: the cells flash white and empty. damaged: cells cracked and dark, a plate hanging; disabled: cold grey cells, the chamber split. Barrel layer kett_hive_swarm_launcher_barrel: a flower of seven honeycomb cells, each with a drone in its mouth; fire: the cells flash and a cloud of drones leaves in a fan.
